capabilities: organize notes into Kanban columns generated from frontmatter properties
drag cards between columns to update their properties and manual order
create new notes directly into a specific column
set per-column WIP limits and collapse columns
filter cards by tag and preview notes on hover
extras: Obsidian 1.14 added a native Bases Kanban layout using the same view type id, so the plugin now registers as base-board and ships a migration command for older boards that still use type: kanban.
intentEvidence: Base Board is an interactive, property-driven Kanban board view for Obsidian Bases.
problem: Obsidian's Bases lacks an interactive Kanban view where moving a card between columns rewrites the note's properties in its Markdown file.
summary: Property-driven Kanban board view for Obsidian Bases that organizes notes into columns with drag-and-drop updates to frontmatter.
